I couldn't read the full text of any of the review pages. Most came back as navigation menus only, and two wouldn't load. So I can't tell you which speaker each outlet ranked first. What follows is based on the product names RTINGS lists and on my own general knowledge, not on tested results from these pages.

**Models to look at** (the RTINGS page lists all of these, but I couldn't confirm their ranking or specs):
- **JBL Flip 7** is a compact, portable option that's usually a good all-rounder for the pool or beach.
- **JBL Charge 6** is bigger and louder, and it usually has longer battery life.
- **JBL Xtreme 5** is a larger speaker for loud group settings.
- **Ultimate UEars WONDERBOOM 4** is small and made for water, and the WONDERBOOM line has floated in past versions.
- **Bose SoundLink Flex (2nd Gen)** is a small, rugged speaker.
- **Soundcore Boom 2 Plus** is a big, loud outdoor speaker. It's the only one with a price I could find in the search results (see below).

**Soundcore Boom 2 Plus deal:** A deal site, Dealectric, says code AFSC20 takes $49.99 off at Soundcore's US store, which would bring the price from $249.99 to about $200. It says it tested this in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22. I couldn't verify that myself, so check that the code still works at checkout. Link: https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus

**Choosing between them:**
- **Pool use:** A speaker that floats is handy, so check that on the product page before you buy.
- **Beach use:** Look for a high dust and sand rating (IP67 or better), since sand can damage a speaker that's only splash-proof.
- **Group use:** The larger speakers (Xtreme 5, Boom 2 Plus) are louder but heavier, and they usually cost more.

**Where to read the rankings yourself:**
- RTINGS: https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth
- Tom's Guide: https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers
- What Hi-Fi?: https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart
